fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
What registrants came for, and whether they got it

A week before a Saturday workshop, each registrant picks the topic they most want covered. The post event survey then names that pick and asks whether today covered it. Both answers sit on one registrant row. Of the 14 people who came for pricing, 5 said yes. Pricing moves to the top of the next agenda.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { conference: "Build a post event survey for my two-day conference. The morning after it closes, email each attendee a list of only the sessions their badge was scanned into, and ask them to rate each one out of 5 with an optional comment. Average the scores by session and track. When a session averages below 3.5, email the program chair the score and every comment.", expoExhibitors: "Build an exhibitor survey for my home show. Two days after it ends, email every exhibitor questions on booth traffic and lead quality, then ask whether they will book again: yes, no, or not sure. Save the answers to each exhibitor's record with their booth number. For any no or not sure, create a follow-up for my sales manager with the booth and the comment.", beforeAndAfter: "Build a pre and post survey for my Saturday workshop. A week before, ask each registrant to pick the topic they most want covered from a list of four. After the workshop, ask them by name whether today covered that topic. Keep both answers on the same registrant row. Show me a count per topic: who came for it and who said yes.", musicFestival: "Build a nightly survey for my three-day music festival. Each evening, email ticket holders a question on how long entry took, scored out of 5. Save each answer with the gate from their ticket scan.
